FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 whole plants in separate large cells. Distinct species silhouettes, realistic branching and restrained local natural palette. Do not turn plants into disconnected bouquets. Botanical labels are concept names, not validated specimens.
